description: This file defines the LeaveRequestDecorator class, which provides methods to interact with and manipulate LeaveRequest entities, including setting employee and leave type references, formatting application dates, and retrieving the latest comment.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionalities for LeaveRequest objects, such as setting related entities, formatting dates, and fetching comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific LeaveRequest entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the LeaveRequest by employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Associates a LeaveType entity to the LeaveRequest by leave type ID.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date the leave request was applied for, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave request.
